label: Granola
description: Arcade tools for Granola meeting intelligence (public Enterprise API)

tools.name: GetMeeting
tools.description:
Get full metadata for one Granola meeting by its note ID.

Does not return notes or transcript content. Fetch the transcript separately with the same
meeting ID.

parameters.name: meeting_id
parameters.description: Granola note ID in format 'not_<14 chars>' (e.g. 'not_XXXXXXXXXXXXXX').

output.description: Full meeting metadata including attendees and calendar event.

tools.name: GetMeetingTranscript
tools.description:
Get the verbatim transcript for a Granola meeting, with speaker labels and timestamps.

Returns all segments by default. Use speaker_filter to narrow to a single speaker.
Note: transcripts can be large for long meetings.

parameters.name: meeting_id
parameters.description: Granola note ID in format 'not_<14 chars>' (e.g. 'not_XXXXXXXXXXXXXX').

parameters.name: speaker_filter
parameters.description: Filter by speaker name (case-insensitive match). Defaults to an empty string, which returns all speakers.

output.description: Transcript segments with speaker labels and timestamps.

tools.name: ListMeetings
tools.description:
List Granola meetings, optionally filtered by date range, with cursor pagination.

Returns metadata only — no notes or transcript content. Results are newest first.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Only return meetings created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to an empty string, which applies no lower bound.

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Only return meetings created before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to an empty string, which applies no upper bound.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results per page (1-30). Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous list_meetings call. Defaults to an empty string, which returns the first page.

output.description: List of meetings with metadata and pagination cursor.

summary:
Arcade toolkit for [Granola](https://www.granola.ai/), a meeting intelligence platform. Enables programmatic access to Granola's Enterprise API to retrieve meeting metadata, transcripts, and paginated meeting lists.

## Capabilities

- **Meeting lookup**: Fetch full metadata for a single meeting by its note ID; transcript content is returned separately via a dedicated call.
- **Transcript retrieval**: Get verbatim transcripts with speaker labels and timestamps; optionally filter to a single speaker. Large transcripts are returned in full — callers should account for size.
- **Meeting listing**: List meetings (newest first) with optional date-range filtering and cursor-based pagination; returns metadata only, no notes or transcript content.

## Secrets

`GRANOLA_API_KEY` — An API key issued by Granola for access to its Enterprise API. Obtain it from your Granola account settings or by contacting Granola support if you are on an Enterprise plan. The key authenticates all requests to the Granola API and must be kept confidential.

Store this secret in Arcade at [https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets). For guidance on using secrets in Arcade tools, see [https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets).
